source_text.body:
Bulk upload documents to a website via browser agent
The poster pairs Claude Desktop for file management with Claude in Chrome to upload many documents to a website.
·
Oct 17, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
The poster had Claude Desktop handle the local file work: renaming and organizing certifications, staging them in batches of 20 because Claude in Chrome could only upload 20 files at a time, and creating an Excel sheet with the form data. Then Claude in Chrome uploaded each batch to the SaaS site and produced a summary for the person to pass back to Desktop, which was then used to mark records in Excel and file the uploaded documents into the right folders.
How it went
For about 150 certifications, the split workflow still saved time, but the poster said the handoff between Desktop and Chrome created too much back and forth and was hard to make smooth for teammates. Commenters suggested moving beyond chat interfaces to Claude CLI or a Python script using the Anthropics API and the SaaS tool's API.
Worth knowing
The main catch was Chrome’s 20-file upload limit, which forced manual batch handoffs between the two Claude environments.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I have a folder of documents at [folder path] that need to go to [website name and upload page URL]. Sort the files by [name, date or category], then upload them one by one in the browser, matching each to the right field or folder on the site. Before you submit anything, show me the full list of what will be uploaded where and wait for my approval. When done, give me a checklist of what succeeded and what failed.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1x1lkn2/uploading_numerous_documents_to_a_website_workflow
